ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area with limited high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at the extreme distal tips and along the trailing edge serrations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across >90% of the visible surface. Fine-grained, low-contrast mottling and lighter grayscale intensities are concentrated near the median notch and the right lobe's medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with an estimated obtuse angle (~130 degrees) and moderate vertical penetration depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly towards the distal tips, presenting a jagged, irregular profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to convex curvature as the contour approaches the distal lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, textured clusters of irregular pixel formations located at the terminal ends of both the left and right lobes, characterized by high spatial frequency and high intensity contrast.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of faint, vertically-oriented, light-colored linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, cutting through the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusions and textured accumulations on the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting heavy colonization or previous trauma.
